title: festuca altaica var. aristulata
intro: Festuca altaica var. aristulata, commonly known as Altai Fescue, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, particularly in its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Altai Fescue include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Altai Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
